reviewedAgainst: Public Main/Transfer prompts and exact rubric rows at repaired M10 v2
question: Does the learner actually perform this capability in the cited fixed assessment, rather than merely using nearby mathematics or encountering the concept in instruction?
policy: No ownership from lesson coverage, mathematical implication or merely related rubric rows. Claims are preserved only when observable; otherwise remap, narrow, repair the task, or remove.
